[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Relation = alias, direction flips, and the == escape[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Bob Mac Capture, `=` is the only relation alias for `~`, and it [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]opens Links To only where Bob's gate allows. A `~` or `=` glued to [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a complete `~note:id` / `~~note:id` flips its direction. The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]relation label card flips direction with `~` / `=` and re-asks Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]for the new direction. A fast `==` types one literal `=` on every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]surface where `=` stands for `~`. Bob stays the only grammar [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]authority, and `bob capture` / `capture-parse` stay literal.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac relation label card flips direction[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]card-flip[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]card-flip: in the Mac relation label card, `~`/`=` flip the relation in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]choose mode, edit the token, re-fetch catalog and verdicts, and support [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a fast `==` literal escape. Also adds teaching keycaps and fixes Escape [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from a Shift-Return card. Mac only.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob capture-rewrite relation grammar[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bob-grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-grammar: in bob-cli capture-rewrite, an `=` opener replaces the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relation `-` alias, `~~=` gives `~`, and a new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`toggle_relation_direction` rule flips a complete token on a glued [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`~`/`=`. Ships with docs, help, and tests as `feat(capture)!`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac adopts the = opener and post-token flip[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-equals-opener[dim] · [dim][/dim]after card-flip, bob-grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-equals-opener: the Mac forwards `=` and token-glued `~` to Bob and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]replaces the dash arm with an equals opener arm that keeps the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Space/Escape restores. It applies `toggle_relation_direction` natively [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]without a picker and deletes every relation `-` path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fast == escape in the editor and picker[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]equals-escape[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-equals-opener[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]equals-escape: one shared equals-gesture record with a ~350 ms [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]key-to-key window, so a fast second `=` undoes whatever the first `=` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]did and types one `=`. Covers the editor before and after Bob replies, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every flip, and the picker; the card reuses it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision record, relation docs, and parity follow-up[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
